caption: The drawing depicts a single, bulbous vessel with a narrow neck and small opening at the top, situated centrally on a plain, off-white background. The vessel is rendered in shades of brown, with the darker and lighter tones accentuating its round, three-dimensional form. Its surface features a prominent diamond or lozenge-shaped incised pattern, creating a textured, quilted appearance. The vessel casts a slight shadow at its base, anchoring it visually to the ground. The artist’s signature, “CHRIS. MARKENOS,” is visible in small text at the bottom right of the vessel. There are no additional objects, colors, or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Pocket Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
